title: Split differentials of a localized symmetric algebra
statement: Let R -> A be a map of commutative rings and M a finite A-module. Set C=Sym_A(M) [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property], with its composite R-algebra structure. Let a in A, S=A_a smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and suppose N=S tensor_A M is projective over S [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Set T=Localization(algebraMapSubmonoid C (powers a)), with its canonical S-algebra structure. Then Omega[T/R] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is S-base-change split: there is a T-linear equivalence Omega[T/R] equiv T tensor_S (N times Omega[S/R]).

source.place: Lemma 07CE proof, final differential decomposition; Algebra 031K and 00S2; More on Algebra 07EV

proof.text: Set S=A_a, N=S tensor_A M, C=Sym_A(M), and T the localization of C at the mapped powers of a. Install the composite R-algebra structure and verify both scalar towers. The localization square is a pushout by Mathlib Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization.

Apply symmetric-algebra baseChange_bijective and the tensor-localization equivalence to identify T with Sym_S(N). Since N is finite projective, smooth_of_finite_projective and invariance under algebra equivalences give Smooth S T.

Choose a finite free surjection pi onto M, put K=ker(pi), and apply the symmetric-algebra cotangent lemma to obtain Omega[C/A] equiv C tensor_A M. KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv for the pushout and the two cancelBaseChange equivalences give Omega[T/S] equiv T tensor_S N.

In the first differential exact sequence for R -> S -> T, Smooth S T makes H1Cotangent S T a subsingleton. Mathlib H1Cotangent.exact_delta_mapBaseChange and LinearMap.injective_iff_eq_zero_of_exact give injectivity of the first map. The last map is surjective and its target is projective. Split it using Mathlib projective lifting and Function.Exact.splitSurjectiveEquiv.
Compose the splitting with the relative differential equivalence, commute the two factors, and apply TensorProduct.prodRight inversely to give Omega[T/R] equiv T tensor_S (N times Omega[S/R]).

lean.statement: theorem localized_differentials_equiv (R : Type u) (A : Type v) (M : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] (a : A) [Algebra.Smooth R (Localization.Away a)] [Module.Projective (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away a ⊗[A] M)] : let C := SymmetricAlgebra A M letI : Algebra R C := ((algebraMap A C).comp (algebraMap R A)).toAlgebra let T := Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (Submonoid.powers a)) Nonempty (KaehlerDifferential R T ≃ₗ[T] T ⊗[Localization.Away a] ((Localization.Away a ⊗[A] M) × KaehlerDifferential R (Localization.Away a)))
